title: Stable influence bounded by noise sensitivity
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $0<\delta$ and $\delta\le\tfrac12$. Then $\delta$ times the total stable influence of the real-valued sign version of $f$, at correlation $1-2\delta$, is at most the noise sensitivity of $f$ at noise rate $\delta$.
